narrative.details: You have accomplished the impossible. The brood mother of the Black Dragonflight lies dead at your feet. Take her head and present it to the Highlord.
narrative.objectives: Take the Head of Onyxia to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind.
narrative.offerRewardText: For so many years I was held under her captivating gaze. Finally, to see justice meted and the honor of Stormwind restored! Today, we celebrate this glorious victory!
